title: OWL got accepted in [red]ICLR 2026[/red]
content: OWL shows how an audio language model can infer where a sound is in 3D space (direction and distance) and provide spatially grounded reasoning steps behind its predictions.

title: Our paper got accepted in [red]ICASSP 2026[/red]
content: This work was carried out during my internship at Meta Reality Labs, in collaboration with the Audio Research Team, where we studied the characteristics of hair-induced noise in smart glasses audio and developed mitigation strategies for robust real-world wearable audio capture.

title: Subrata receives [red]Peter B. Meyers Fellowship[/red]
content: This fellowship highlights Subrata’s hard work and excellence in graduate scholarship.

title: EfficientMic got accepted in [red]BuildSys'25[/red]
content: EfficientMic detects aliasing in real time to adapt sampling with just one mic. [red](Led by Jack)[/red]

title: Mindfulness Meditation and Respiration got accepted in [red]IMWUT/UbiComp'25[/red]
content: This work introduces smartphone-based respiration tracking and mindfulness skill estimation to enhance engagement and usability in digital meditation apps. [red](Led by Nur)[/red]

title: LYNX got accepted in [red]MIT URTC'25[/red] as a Poster
content: Three high school students developed an open-source multimodal earable for data collection. [red](Led by Hikmet, Musa, Pranav)[/red]

title: RAVEN got accepted in [red]EMNLP'25[/red]
content: RAVEN improves multimodal question answering by dynamically gating cross-modal signals—using a single architecture to suppress distractors and resolve modality mismatches. [red](Led by Subrata)[/red]

title: LLaSA got accepted in in [red]GENAI4HS Workshop, UbiComp'25[/red]
content: LLaSA combines IMU data with language models to generate interpretable, context-rich answers about human activity using large-scale sensor-caption and QA datasets.. [red](Led by Shoubornno)[/red]

title: LOCUS got accepted in [red]EWSN'25[/red]
content: LOCUS enables robust sound source localization in batteryless systems by intelligently recovering missing multichannel data using deep learning. [red](Led by Subrata)[/red]

title: QuaDS got accepted in [red]Interspeech'25[/red]
content: QUADS unifies quantization and distillation to create ultra-efficient spoken language understanding models. [red](Led by Subrata)[/red]

title: FATE got accepted in [red]MWSCAS'25[/red]
content: Fate is a novel Fourier-Accelerated CMOS-based Tensor Engine that optimizes matrix multiplication using the Fourier Dot Product. [red](Led by Jack)[/red]

title: Shourno went to [red]Bosch Research Labs[/red] as Summer Research Intern
InfantMotion2Vec got accepted in [red]BSN'24[/red]
content: InfantMotion2Vec uses a single IMU sensor and semi-supervised learning to detect infant pose to facilitate neurodevelopmental risks in infants through natural motion analysis. [red](Led by Nur)[/red]

title: Ultrasound-Gesture got accepted in [red]BSN'24[/red]
content: This work enables real-time hand gesture recognition using forearm ultrasound and deep learning on edge devices, achieving high accuracy with efficient model compression. [red](Led by Keshav)[/red]

title: Subrata went to [red]Meta Reality Lab[/red] as Summer Research Intern and Part-time Student Researcher
FreeML got accepted in [red]EWSN'24[/red]
content: FreeML enables memory-efficient, energy-adaptive inference of pre-trained deep neural networks on batteryless systems using novel compression and early-exit techniques. [red](Led by Subrata)[/red]

title: Infant SoundTagging got accepted in [red]CHASE'24[/red]
content: This work enhances infant-centric noise detection by fine-tuning large audio models on data from wearable infant recorders, improving accuracy in real-world home soundscapes. [red](Led by Nur)[/red]

title: EchoSense got accepted in [red]MIT URTC'23[/red]
content: This work explores using acoustic sensing and machine learning to identify and monitor the shape and health of small hollow objects with high accuracy for preventive maintenance in enclosed environments. [red](Led by Michael and Zhuolin)[/red]

title: Bashima presents Amalgamated Intermittent Systems in [red]IoTDI'23[/red]
content: This work explores energy-aware coordination of intermittent computing nodes with unequal energy harvesting, enabling reliable sensing and computation without constant communication.

title: Subrata presents poster in [red]SenSys'22[/red]
content: This work reveals how prior data knowledge enables input recovery from partially offloaded DNN vectors, highlighting privacy risks in edge-cloud inference.

title: Verification of Intermittent Systems got accepted in [red]EMSOFT'22[/red]
content: This paper present formal verification of intermittent computing system powered by harvester energy. [red](Led by Rose & Bashima)[/red]

title: [red]BASH[/red] Lab starts its journey at WPI
